title: fix(plugin-charts): a dataset object-chart draws a select dimension in declared option order (objectui#13403)
body:
Closes #13403
Clause-②: no

## What changed

A page-level `object-chart` bound to a `dataset` now draws a select dimension in its field's declared option order, as the dashboard's `DatasetWidget` already does for the same dataset (objectui#11809). The showcase command center's priority panel read 高, 低, 中, 紧急 (the GROUP BY order of `high, low, medium, urgent`) and now reads 低 → 中 → 高 → 紧急.

`packages/plugin-charts/src/ObjectChart.tsx` is the only source file touched:

- The memo that already derives the option colours and dimension labels from the first dimension's localized options now also derives `categoryOrder` with `@object-ui/core`'s `buildCategoryOrder`. This applies on the dataset path only, and only when the chart names a dimension. A field with no options gives `null`, so nothing changes for it.
- The rows are sorted by that order before `buildChartSeries`: declared options first, then values the options do not declare, then the empty bucket. The sort is stable. The order is put on the rows because `AdvancedChartImpl` reads `categoryOrder` only in its funnel branch. A bar, line or pie draws its rows in the order it receives them, which is also why the dashboard sorts its `plotRows` itself.
- The schema handed to `ChartRenderer` carries `categoryOrder`, the same key the dashboard hands it, which the funnel orders its stages by.

## Judgment calls (premise check)

- **No helper move.** `buildCategoryOrder` and `buildCategoryRank` already live in `@object-ui/core`, which `plugin-charts` depends on. `DatasetWidget.tsx` is untouched.
- **Passing `categoryOrder` alone would not have fixed the card.** The card's mechanism is that "`AdvancedChartImpl` honours it through `buildCategoryRank(categoryOrder)`". On `main` that holds only for the funnel. The card's own panels are bars, so the rows had to be ordered as well. `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` is untouched (another agent is editing it).
- **One local helper, `declaredOptionPosition`.** It applies the same rule as the private function of the same name in `DatasetWidget`. `DatasetReportRenderer` has a third private copy. Moving it to `@object-ui/core` would add a core file to this card's declared surface, so this PR does not do it. It is recorded below as a possible follow-up.
- **Gate is "the field declares options", not "the field type is select".** This matches the dashboard: `DimensionFieldMeta` carries no field type, and `buildCategoryOrder` returns `null` for a field without options.

## Tests

New file `packages/plugin-charts/src/ObjectChart.categoryOrder-13403.test.tsx`, 3 tests:

- The card's shape. Answered rows `high, low, medium, urgent` reach the renderer as 低, 中, 高, 紧急, with their measures `[2, 7, 5, 1]`, and `categoryOrder` equals `buildCategoryOrder(options)`, which is `['low','低','medium','中','high','高','urgent','紧急']`.
- A value the options do not declare (`blocked`) comes after the declared ones, and the null bucket comes last.
- Control: a dimension whose field declares no options gets no `categoryOrder` key and keeps the dataset's answered order.

Results at head `2fa5702bc3`:

- New file: 3/3 passed.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-charts/`: 98 files, 1268 passed, 9 skipped.
- Dashboard #11809 controls, unchanged: `DatasetWidget.selectOptionOrder-11809.test.tsx` and `DatasetWidget.optionLabelI18n.test.tsx`, 2 files, 15/15 passed.
- `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/plugin-charts...`: 19/19 tasks successful. `plugin-dashboard` was not touched.
- `eslint` on the two touched files: 0 errors and 35 warnings. The same file at base also gives 35 warnings, so none are new.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: passes (one patch changeset for `@object-ui/plugin-charts`).
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: 0 new.

Ablation was run on the committed fix, restored with `git checkout HEAD`, and the restored blob hash matches HEAD:

- Leg A, row sort disabled: 2 failed, 1 passed (the two ordering tests fail; the control passes).
- Leg B, `categoryOrder` hand-off removed: 2 failed, 1 passed.

## Acceptance notes

- The second dimension's series order is not applied on this path. The dashboard also orders a pivoted second select dimension's legend (`seriesOrder`, objectui#11809). The card names the category axis only, so this PR leaves the series as they are.
- `ChartRenderer`'s doc comment on `categoryOrder` still says it is "Set by DatasetWidget". `ObjectChart` now sets it too. `ChartRenderer.tsx` is outside this card's surface.
- `declaredOptionPosition` now has three private copies: `DatasetWidget`, `DatasetReportRenderer` and `ObjectChart`. A single home in `@object-ui/core` is a possible follow-up.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
